authority_backbone: POWO/WCVP (checked 2026-10-24); Wipff & Shaw 2018 Phytoneuron primary treatment; 2024 Anatherum combinations per POWO
scope: Existing canonical Poaceae Anatherum tenuispatheum: accepted name, rank, 7 historical synonyms, distinct A. eremicum/glomeratum/virginicum boundaries, specimen/hybrid holds

decisions.reason: Accepted Poaceae species at species rank under POWO/WCVP; 2024 combination, no canonical rename.
Homotypic synonym under POWO, not modern accepted Anatherum virginicum.
Homotypic basionym (1903); historical placement under glomeratus does not imply accepted modern glomeratum.
Homotypic historical species combination (1912); retained as synonym of accepted 2024 combination.
Homotypic form-rank synonym under POWO; do not route to accepted Anatherum virginicum.

decisions.source_name: Andropogon virginicus var. tenuispatheus (Nash) Fernald & Griscom

decisions.reason: Heterotypic synonym, robust variant of Campbell's historical pumilus concept; do not conflate with scabriglumis Southwestern variant.
Heterotypic synonym under POWO, with Val Verde County historical type cited by Wipff and Shaw.
Separate accepted species under POWO; 2018 Andropogon eremicus replaces Southwestern historical variety, later combined in Anatherum in 2024.
Separate accepted species under POWO; broad historical glomeratus complexes must not be mapped wholesale.
Separate accepted species under POWO; historical tenuispatheus combinations under virginicus do not belong to modern virginicum.

decisions.source_name: Proposal to merge Andropogon glomeratus var. scabriglumis into Anatherum tenuispatheum
decisions.reason: The Southwestern var. scabriglumis concept corresponds to accepted Anatherum eremicum, not tenuispatheum. Source orthography discrepancy separately unresolved.

decisions.source_name: Proposal to route all Andropogon glomeratus var. pumilus/tenuispatheus to Anatherum glomeratum
decisions.reason: POWO separates accepted Anatherum tenuispatheum from A. glomeratum; historical shared parent name does not override author/rank/synonym destinations.

decisions.source_name: Existing source-determined Anatherum tenuispatheum learner photographs and vouchers
decisions.reason: Canonical file explicitly lacks independent measured ligule, sheath, and mature sessile spikelet evidence; nomenclature cannot certify individual images. Preserve provisional ID hold.

decisions.source_name: Hybrid parentage for individual Anatherum tenuispatheum learner specimen
decisions.reason: Reviewed sources establish no specimen-specific hybrid ancestry; do not assign a hybrid formula or clear any preexisting identity hold.

decisions.source_name: Orthography of historical Andropogon glomeratus var. scabriglumis/scabriglumus
decisions.reason: 2018 Wipff & Shaw repeatedly print scabriglumis, while POWO displays scabriglumus C.S.Campb.; confirm Campbell 1986 protologue before normalizing historic strings. Both sources agree on the accepted eremicum destination.

decisions.source_name: Authorless historical Andropogon glomeratus var. pumilus or broad Andropogon virginicus complex specimens
decisions.reason: Wipff & Shaw document robust versus Southwestern variants; incomplete old labels alone do not identify specimens without locality, morphology, original concept and voucher review.

limitations: POWO's spelling scabriglumus and the 2018 primary spelling scabriglumis differ; do not silently normalize before examining Campbell 1986 protologue.
Historical labels and source-determined photos require specimen-level morphology and voucher evidence; taxonomy synonymy alone cannot certify photographed identity.
